name: London (Hyde Park)
note: Hyde Park + Kensington Gardens and the streets around them (Bayswater, Knightsbridge, Mayfair's west edge): a test city for the evidence-based trees (lawns open, the avenues and woods treed). No LiDAR, no DEM: flat ground at 1 m with the Serpentine and the Long Water carved below it; heights from OSM (height, building:levels) or neighbours / class defaults.
